items.exampleEn: We had an awesome time at the beach.
items.exampleZh: 我們在海灘度過了很棒的時光。

items.exampleEn: There has been a marked change in his behavior.
items.exampleZh: 他的行為有了明顯的改變。

items.exampleEn: His handwriting is so messy that nobody can read it.
items.exampleZh: 他的字跡凌亂到沒有人看得懂。

items.exampleEn: In the past, piano keys were made of ivory.
items.exampleZh: 以前鋼琴的琴鍵是用象牙做的。
今晚的月亮看起來圓圓的。

items.exampleEn: This book is for intermediate learners.
items.exampleZh: 這本書是給中級程度的學習者看的。

items.sentenceEn: Eating with your hands can be messy.
items.sentenceZh: 用手吃東西可能會弄得一團亂。

items.audioEn: Sorry, the table is sticky. Someone spilled juice on it.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，桌子黏黏的，有人把果汁灑在上面。
options: A child dropped some ice cream on it.
The waiter put too much honey on it.

items.sentenceEn: The kids walked in a circular path around the tree.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們繞著樹走了一圈。
奇怪的是，沒有人接電話。

items.stemEn: I can't find anything in this ____ room!
items.stemZh: 在這個凌亂的房間裡我什麼都找不到！

items.stemEn: In summer, the air here is hot and ____.
items.stemZh: 夏天這裡的空氣又熱又黏。

items.passageEn: Last week, I joined an intermediate cooking class. The kitchen had a circular table in the middle, and everything looked awesome. Our teacher showed us how to make honey cakes. The honey made my hands sticky, and soon my area was very messy. My first cake was a little dry. But I tried again, and strangely, my second cake turned out better than everyone else's! The teacher said there was a marked difference between my first cake and my second one. I was delighted. She also showed us an old ivory spoon from her grandmother. She said people don't use ivory anymore because elephants need protection.
items.passageZh: 上週，我參加了一堂中級烹飪課。廚房中間有一張圓形的桌子，一切看起來都很棒。老師教我們做蜂蜜蛋糕。蜂蜜讓我的手黏黏的，我的位置很快就變得很凌亂。我的第一個蛋糕有點乾。但我又試了一次，奇怪的是，第二個蛋糕竟然做得比其他人都好！老師說，我的第一個和第二個蛋糕有明顯的差別。我非常高興。她還給我們看了一支她祖母留下的舊象牙湯匙。她說現在大家已經不用象牙了，因為大象需要保護。

questions.questionZh: 作者的位置為什麼變得很亂？
options: 旁邊的同學把麵粉灑到地上

questions.questionZh: 老師說現在為什麼不用象牙了？
options: 因為象牙做的湯匙太容易斷了
因為象牙的價錢實在太貴了

referenceEn: The concert last night was awesome!
rubricZh: awesome 表示「很棒的」，例如 an awesome concert 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 messy 造一個句子，說說你家或你房間的某個地方。
referenceEn: My desk gets messy when I study for exams.
My hair is always messy in the morning.
rubricZh: messy 表示「凌亂的」，例如 a messy room 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式；說過去的事用過去式等）
